title: RED Quiz Genrator
features:
Key Features:
​🤖 Dynamic AI Generation: Type ANY topic you want (e.g., "Science," "Roblox History," "Anime"), and the AI will instantly generate high-quality quiz questions and answers.
​💬 Server-Wide Chat Integration: The script acts as a host, dropping questions directly into the main server chat for everyone to see and participate.
​🎯 Smart Answer Detection: Automatically scans the server chat to instantly detect which player answered correctly first. No manual checking needed!
​🛡️ Advanced Anti-Cheat & Ban System: Strictly monitors for cheating or spamming. Includes an automated ban/kick system to punish players trying to break the quiz.
​🚦 Full Quiz Controls & Delay Settings: Total control in your hands. Start, stop, or pause the quiz at any time. Configure custom delay timers between questions.
​🚀 Anti-Rate Limit (Bypass 429 Errors): Built with an extremely smart request queuing system. Say goodbye to HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) errors! The API connection is incredibly stable.
​🛠️ How to Use:
​Execute the script using your preferred executor.
​Enter your desired Quiz Topic in the input field.
​Set your delay preferences and anti-cheat strictness.
​Hit Start! Watch as the script takes over the chat and engages the whole server.
